data.body: ADR 0098 has been drafted and pushed as Gerrit change 1840 in WIP. The draft records the approved operation snapshot, provider-native auth/session injection, static carrier, subprocess, restart/redeploy, observability, and op-cert startup decisions. Generator/index/docs/lint checks pass. The numbered Draft Critique is on miniscule-unschooled-snowmonkey and has no unresolved item. The ADR remains a blocking prerequisite; this epic stays open and unclaimed pending explicit HOLD approval and later implementation decomposition.
